Name: Alternative Shane Girl Sprite (for Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes)
Author: gale2897
Description:
This is an alternative sprite meant to be installed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/22709859]invatorzen[/url]. The original is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1946]Shane girl mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51528986]exrenkon[/url], which I used as reference. I made it so that it would blend better with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2165]Adarin's girl mod[/url] (which is compiled in invatorzen's dialogue changes) by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1156362]Adarin Sinner[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Shie's Portraits[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72274698]Shie[/url]. Now includes Clothing Therapy and Ginger Island sprites as well.

Note that this does not have its own portrait. This is also NOT a standalone mod, and requires Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes. Most of the mod does not have a separate Content Patcher folder, nor does it have xnb files that you can directly replace files with. 

This mod includes 5 files:
- Shane base sprite
- Shane joja mart sprite
- Cursors loosesprite (which also happens to have the sabrina[girl seb] bike because it was in the file I edited)
- Clothing Therapy sprite
- Ginger Island sprite (based on Shie's portraits)

To install, [b]make sure that invatorzen's dialogue changes has already been installed[/b], and then just "extract here" the rar file which should prompt you to overwrite a few files. (Either do this or move the files directly to the corresponding folder, I'm sure you people know how to do it) You should also have a separate CP folder for the Clothing Therapy and Ginger Island sprites (other files still directly replacing files in invatorzen's mod).

To update, make sure to remove original [CP] folder.

Downloads.Description: Includes all sprites. Now includes Ginger Island sprites.
